job.title: Associate Software Developer
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

You need a developer who delivers clean, tested code from day one – I bring 5+ years of Java and Spring development on enterprise e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell.

– Developed OCC REST web services (headless APIs) for storefronts, PWA frontends and third-party consumers
– Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed
– Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2)
– Used generative AI / LLM tools extensively across analysis, development, testing and documentation

I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. Would you have 15 minutes for a short call in the coming days? My CV and cover letter are attached.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Software Developer | Java, Spring Boot & REST APIs | Enterprise E-Commerce
tailoring.summary: Software developer with 5+ years of professional experience building and supporting enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and query performance tuning. Builds automated unit and integration tests with JUnit, works with Git and CI/CD pipelines, Docker and Kubernetes, and supports production troubleshooting. Uses AI-assisted development daily. Collaborates closely with business stakeholders in agile, international teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: Your Associate Software Developer role is a chance to apply solid engineering fundamentals in a team that values quality. I bring five years of professional Java, Spring and REST API work on enterprise platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell, plus testing with JUnit and CI/CD delivery, and I want to put that experience to work on your products.

en.subject: Application: Associate Software Developer
en.hook: You are looking for a software developer who writes clean, reliable code and grows quickly into your systems. I bring more than five years of professional Java development on large enterprise e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell – from REST APIs and data integrations to tests, deployments and production support.

bullets.label: Software development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality with Java and Spring on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211), following design patterns and platform best practices.

bullets.label: APIs & integrations
bullets.text: Built RESTful APIs and OCC web services for headless and PWA frontends; consumed and exposed REST and SOAP web services for third-party systems.

bullets.label: Code quality & testing
bullets.text: Built automated unit and integration test suites with JUnit, performed code reviews and led database query refactoring that reduced response latency.

bullets.label: Delivery & support
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds within agile DevOps workflows and supported production troubleshooting and maintenance.

en.logistics: I work well in agile, international teams and use AI tools daily to speed up analysis, development and testing. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would welcome a conversation about how I can contribute to your development team.
